method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Eight-week winning streak extends – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that the S&P 500 has logged an eighth consecutive weekly gain, supported by falling Oil prices and easing stagflation fears. Futures are modestly higher after the long weekend, though slightly below pre-strike levels.
Equities.reason: Signals broad equity momentum and a market regime tilted toward risk-on as stagflation fears ease and oil falls — supportive for the S&P and risk assets overall.

Equities.title: Emerging Stocks Extend Rally as AI Boom Outweighs Iran Doubts
Equities.reason: Reinforces dominant market narrative that AI-led tech demand is driving equity flows, overpowering geopolitics — bullish for EM/tech-heavy indices and supportive of continued risk appetite.

Equities.title: Wall St futures gain on US-Iran peace talk hopes
Equities.reason: Short-term risk-on reaction to geopolitical optimism that lifts futures — a direct market-flow impulse into equities ahead of the cash open.

Equities.title: US strikes Iranian missile sites as peace talks continue
Equities.summary: Washington announces ‘self-defence’ operation against targets in southern Iran
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation is a negative for risk assets and could raise risk premia/volatility; serves as a countervailing force to peace-related rallies.

Equities.title: ‘The market has spoken’: Ferrari shares fall 6% after carmaker unveils first fully electric vehicle
Equities.summary: Shares of luxury carmaker Ferrari fell sharply on Tuesday morning, shortly after the company launched its first fully electric vehicle.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic single-stock/sector reaction to product unveiling; negative for Ferrari and potentially nearby auto/luxury peers but low relevance to broad market regime.

Equities.title: Here are the 3 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
Equities.summary: The holiday-shortened week of trading will address key debates including AI's impact on software and inflation.
Equities.reason: Highlights the primary market-forward themes (AI leadership and inflation trajectory) that will drive positioning and sector leadership in the near term.

Equities.title: Qualcomm's stock pop shows investors are 'waking up' to boom in AI devices
Equities.summary: Qualcomm is on a big run, powered by investor bullishness that the company will be at the center of a boom in AI devices.
Equities.reason: Company-level move that signals broader sector rotation into AI-related semiconductors — supportive for tech leadership and market momentum.

Equities.title: The Risk Premium for Holding Stocks Over Bonds Is Vanishing
Equities.reason: Important macro/valuation theme: shrinking equity risk premium raises downside vulnerability and suggests market upside may be limited absent further liquidity or earnings upside.

Equities.title: TSMC’s Relentless Rise Powers Taiwan’s Market Value Above India
Equities.reason: Concentration of market cap in TSMC underscores tech/semiconductor-driven equity leadership and the skew in index performance toward a few mega-cap winners.

Equities.title: Real wages start to shrink in developed countries
Equities.summary: Strait of Hormuz crisis pushes price growth ahead of pay increases in US, UK and elsewhere
Equities.reason: Erosion of real incomes linked to energy-driven price growth is a negative for consumer demand outlook and poses a headwind to cyclically exposed equities.

Rates.title: BOJ Deputy Chief Underlines Proper Policy as Key for Bond Yields
Rates.reason: BOJ official comments about bond yields suggest the central bank sees a role for policy guidance/management of yields. That is bond-positive (supports prices / lower yields) for JGBs and helps the global dovish bias in rates markets.

Rates.title: Treasury yields slide after Memorial Day break as traders weigh Iran peace prospects
Rates.summary: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — fell more than 6 basis points to 4.510%.
Rates.reason: Direct market move: UST 10y fell >6bp as Iran peace prospects reduced risk premia. Clear, immediate bond-positive signal for core rates and risk sentiment.

Rates.title: Treasuries Rally as Trump Signals Progress in Iran Negotiations
Rates.reason: Reports linking easing geopolitical risk (progress in Iran talks) to rallying Treasuries reinforces short-term downward pressure on yields and reduces risk premium across sovereign curves.

Rates.title: Treasury Curve Flashes Higher-for-Longer Warning Under Warsh
Rates.reason: Analysis highlighting the curve signalling 'higher-for-longer' under the new Fed chair is a significant market signal toward structurally higher yields (bond-negative) and raises the chance of persistent rate risk priced into USTs.

Rates.title: Fed: Hawkish risks for rates – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY’s John Velis and David Tam note that recent FOMC minutes and comments from Fed Governor Waller point to higher two‑way risk for US interest rates.
Rates.reason: BNY flags increased hawkish risk from Fed communications—this raises the probability of higher UST yields or greater volatility (bond-negative / higher rate uncertainty).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary source of policy intent; recent minutes have been interpreted by market participants as leaving upside risks to policy (greater rate persistence), so they modestly tilt bond sentiment negative.

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.summary: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.reason: Change in Fed leadership is a major structural input for rates. Markets are repricing policy stance and term premium under the new chairman; this is market-moving and leans bond-negative given the surrounding higher-for-longer commentary.

Rates.title: Singapore reports lower-than-expected inflation for April at 1.8%, revises economic growth higher
Rates.summary: Core inflation — which strips out prices of private transport and accommodation — came in at 1.4%, against estimates of 1.7%.
Rates.reason: Lower-than-expected inflation in a regional economy is modestly supportive for Asian sovereign bonds and reduces regional inflation pressure, a bond-positive datapoint for rates markets.

Rates.title: China Lets Policy Loan Rate Fall to Record Low to Boost Economy
Rates.reason: PBOC easing via a lower policy loan rate is domestically bond-positive and can put modest downward pressure on regional yields; relevance is lower for global core rates but still contributes to easing bias.

Rates.title: European stocks highest since March 2 as U.S.-Iran talks continue; euro zone bond yields drop on peace hopes
Rates.summary: Stocks in Europe are tracking their Asian counterparts higher after Japan's Nikkei 225 breached 65,000 for the first time.
Rates.reason: Article links easing geopolitical tensions to falling euro-zone bond yields. This is a direct transmission to European rates (bond-positive) and reinforces the regional move lower in sovereign yields.

FX.title: Euro: ECB hawkishness fails to lift versus US Dollar – Societe Generale
FX.summary: The report by Societe Generale notes that Eurozone yields are slightly firmer after hawkish comments from ECB member Schnabel, who highlights rising medium-term inflation expectations and signals a likely rate hike in June.
FX.reason: FX-native item: ECB hawkish talk but EUR not gaining vs USD implies USD resilience/strength dominates. Relevant to EUR/USD flows and yield differentials; medium-high relevance.

FX.title: Euro strengthens against British Pound as ECB signals June hike
FX.summary: The EUR/GBP cross gathers strength to near 0.8630 during the early European session on Tuesday. Hawkish remarks from the ‌European Central Bank (ECB) provide some support to the Euro (EUR) against the British Pound (GBP).
FX.reason: Cross-specific FX move: ECB hawkishness supporting EUR vs GBP. Useful for EUR/GBP flows; moderate relevance as it signals cross-rate positioning rather than broader USD-basket move.

FX.title: Euro: Limited upside against US Dollar within neutral band – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe EUR/USD as neutral after a sharp opening rise, with only modest upward momentum. They see scope for the Euro to edge higher but doubt a sustained break of nearby resistance.
FX.reason: Technical/range-bound note on EUR/USD. FX-relevant but non-directional; treated as informational with limited relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risks against Sterling below 0.8610 – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux highlights that EUR/GBP is trading within a Head and Shoulders pattern, implying potential downside if key levels give way.
FX.reason: Technical risk flag on EUR/GBP implying potential EUR weakness vs GBP. Relevant for cross-rate risk but lower relevance than macro-driven USD-basket stories.

FX.title: British Pound underperforms as UK gilt yields hit monthly low near 4.82%
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades lower against its major currency peers, is down 0.25% to near 1.3470 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: GBP underperformance tied to weaker UK gilt yields — direct FX transmission via yield differential; medium relevance for GBP/USD and GBP-cross positioning.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Dollar ticks up to 159.00 as Iran’s peace talks wobble
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) appreciates against the Japanese Yen (JPY) for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, hitting session highs above 159.00 at the time of writing, as fresh US attacks on Iran put the peace process into question.
FX.reason: Geopolitical-driven USD safe-haven/strength (USD/JPY >159). USD strength is negative for broad FX and EM; high relevance given magnitude and geopolitical catalyst.

FX.title: USD Dollar Index (DXY) Price Forecast: Clings to gains above 99.00, near 23.6% Fibo.
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, regains positive traction on Tuesday and reverses part of the previous day's slide to a one-week low.
FX.reason: DXY technical/price action shows USD regaining traction; USD strength is broadly negative for non-USD FX. Technical note so capped relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Hurdles cap upside into 2026 – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities strategists argue that, despite stronger United States (US) data and renewed "US exceptionalism" narratives, they are not ready to abandon their bearish US Dollar (USD) thesis for 2026.
FX.reason: Macro FX view arguing USD upside is capped — implies potential relief for other currencies. Relevant to medium-term USD-basket narrative and positioning.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar stabilizes as tensions in Strait of Hormuz escalate
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, May 26:
FX.reason: Daily FX wrap noting USD stabilisation amid Middle East tensions—signals safe-haven USD demand and near-term risk to non-USD FX. Timely and moderately relevant.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar slides below mid-0.5800s vs USD amid Iran risks, ahead of RBNZ decision
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair comes under renewed selling pressure on Tuesday and slide back below mid-0.5800s during the first half of the European session.
FX.reason: NZD weakness vs USD tied to geopolitical risk and upcoming RBNZ decision — direct FX move with market-relevant drivers; medium-high relevance for ANZ/EM flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Neutral versus US Dollar inside tight corridor – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that AUD/USD broke above a cited resistance but the move lacked follow-through, leaving the pair likely to consolidate. They have shifted to a neutral stance, viewing recent price action as range-bound.
FX.reason: Range-bound technical view on AUD/USD; FX-relevant but non-directional, limited signal to broader USD-basket narrative.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Stays above 0.7150, tests nine-day EMA barrier
FX.summary: AUD/USD loses ground after registering over 0.5% gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7160 during the European hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Short-term technical/price-forecast note showing slight AUD weakness vs USD. Technical content limits relevance; still indicates USD support amid recent flows.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Consolidates in narrow range as strong confluence caps gains
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair extends its sideways consolidative price move for the second straight day on Tuesday and holds steady near the 1.3800 mark through the first half of the European session.
FX.reason: Technical consolidation in USD/CAD; relevant to CAD flows especially given oil link, but currently non-directional and lower relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee fails to extend four-day winning streak as oil prices rebound
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee’s (INR) rally against the US Dollar (USD) hits a pause after a four-day winning streak on Tuesday.
FX.reason: INR pause tied to oil rebound and geopolitical concerns — direct EMFX move with commodity transmission; medium relevance for EM currency sensitivity to oil and risk-off.

FX.title: Yuan May Hit Five Per Dollar on Carry-Trade Exit, Macquarie Says
FX.reason: Headline suggests potential CNY weakness (USD/CNY to ~5) driven by carry-trade dynamics — significant FX implication for EM/Asia and global USD demand; high relevance.

FX.title: (BOJ Review) Developments in and Characteristics of Japan's FX Market: An Analysis Based on the 2025 BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey
FX.reason: Institutional research on FX market structure; informational and low-signal for immediate directional positioning, hence minimal relevance and neutral direction.

FX.title: Euro struggles against Canadian Dollar as oil prices rebound
FX.summary: EUR/CAD depreciates after four days of losses, trading around 1.6060 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency cross loses ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) remains firm amid higher crude oil prices.
FX.reason: Commodity-driven CAD strength (oil) weighing on EUR/CAD — direct FX transmission from oil to CAD, relevant for CAD crosses and commodity-linked FX flows.

Commodities.title: WTI extends recovery from two-week low, approaches $92.00 on US-Iran and Hormuz risks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – regains some positive traction on Tuesday and recovers a part of the previous day's heavy losses to the $88.75-$88.70 region, or over a two-week low.
Commodities.reason: Clear oil supply-risk narrative (US–Iran/Hormuz) lifting crude prices; large direct impact on physical oil markets and energy risk premia, high relevance to commodities pricing.

Commodities.title: Gold slips as US-Iran tensions lift oil, stoke inflation fears
Commodities.reason: Gold reacting negatively to USD/real-rate strength and hawkish Fed bets despite geopolitics; direct, high‑signal move for precious metals driven by rate/FX cross‑winds.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $76.06 per troy ounce, down 2.56% from the $78.06 it cost on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Direct price move in a physical metal; silver down materially on the day, reflecting both base‑metal and precious‑metal spillovers from risk/FX and oil/geo headlines.

Commodities.title: Copper Holds Gain as Traders Track Prospects for US-Iran Deal
Commodities.reason: Copper responding to geopolitical outlook and demand sentiment; modest positive as supply/demand narrative and risk sentiment support industrial metal prices.

Commodities.title: Wheat Extends Decline as Traders Digest Iran Ceasefire Talks
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical de‑risking (ceasefire talks) reduces supply‑risk premium for agricultural commodities tied to regional disruptions; direct price signal for grains.

Commodities.title: Brazil’s Cotton Farmers Cash in on Rally Fueled by Obstacles Worlds Away
Commodities.reason: Reported supply constraints and global obstacles lifting cotton prices; meaningful commodity-specific rally with direct relevance to physical cotton markets.

Commodities.title: Ghana to Start Buying 30% of Large Gold Mines’ Ouput From June
Commodities.reason: Material policy change reducing export/marketable supply from a major gold producer is supportive for gold prices and market structure; high relevance to bullion market fundamentals.

Commodities.title: Malaysia Jolts Bullion Trade With 10% Import Duty on Gold Bars
Commodities.reason: Policy/tax change affects local physical flows and trading patterns in bullion; modest, localized impact on gold market liquidity and demand.

Commodities.title: Indonesia Probes Major Palm Oil Companies on Export Price Issues
Commodities.reason: Government probe introduces regulatory uncertainty for a major vegetable‑oil supplier; potential to affect export flows and prices but outcome and market impact uncertain.

Commodities.title: Japan Set to Secure More Oil Imports in May After April Slump
Commodities.reason: Higher month‑on‑month oil imports from a major buyer support crude demand; modestly positive for oil balances and prices.

Commodities.title: Swiss Trader Had Lucrative Role Getting Iraqi Oil Through Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Illustrates market workarounds and logistics for Middle East crude flows; informative on supply channels but limited incremental price impact.

Commodities.title: Gold Gains as Prospects of Iran Deal Temper Inflation Concerns
Commodities.reason: Counter‑signal: progress on diplomatic talks eases oil/inflation fears and supports safe‑haven gold on lower real‑rate expectations; included with lower relevance as a partial offset to prevailing tensions-driven narrative.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin trades above $77,000 as oil's 5% slide pushes Asian equities higher
Crypto.reason: Short-term risk-on flow: cross-asset move (oil drop -> equities) lifting BTC. Signals crypto is still tracking macro risk appetite, supportive for prices in the near term.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin stalls near $76,500 as muted trading points to macro wait-and-see
Crypto.reason: Consolidation/uncertainty: muted volumes and macro caution increase downside vulnerability in the near term, a modest negative for market momentum.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin caught between critical onchain support and an options showdown
Crypto.reason: Technical vulnerability + concentrated options expiries raise the risk of short-term volatility and downside squeezes; negative for immediate price stability.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin options are coming to Nasdaq. Here's what it means for you
Crypto.reason: Material institutionalization/liquidity advance: Nasdaq-listed BTC options expand market infrastructure and attract institutional flow, a significant positive for market depth and adoption.

Crypto.title: HYPE funds attract millions as investors dump bitcoin and ether ETFs
Crypto.reason: Flow rotation: capital moving from core BTC/ETH ETFs into speculative HYPE funds indicates shifting investor preferences and sustained retail/speculative appetite—mildly positive for alt/speculative segments, mixed for core assets.

Crypto.title: PCE, jobless claims and housing data test Fed cut hopes: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: Macro risk channel: US data that dents Fed-cut expectations would be negative for risk assets including crypto; macro calendar is the dominant near-term driver of crypto flows.

Crypto.title: Buterin says Ethereum Foundation will shrink, sell less ETH, and focus on 'CROPS'
Crypto.reason: Supply-side improvement for ETH: reduced foundation selling is a constructive, directly pro-price development for Ethereum, material at the protocol level.

Crypto.title: Crypto rails are becoming the default payment layer for AI agents, report says
Crypto.reason: Structural adoption thesis: integration of crypto payment rails with AI agents supports long-term utility and demand for on-chain payments and token usage; medium-high relevance for thematic upside.

Crypto.title: AI is speeding up the quantum threat to crypto, security experts warn
Crypto.reason: Security/technology risk: accelerating quantum-threat timelines raise long-term cryptographic risk and could weigh on sentiment and institutional willingness to engage; relevant but lower immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: Nine Crypto Whales Dominate Polymarket Disputes Worth Billions
Crypto.reason: Concentration risk: dominance by a few large holders in a major prediction market highlights market manipulation/centralization concerns, negative for trust in DeFi/prediction platforms.

Crypto.title: Indonesia blocks Polymarket, calling prediction market online gambling in disguise
Crypto.reason: Regulatory headwind: jurisdictional crackdown on prediction markets is a localized negative for on-chain betting/derivatives products and highlights ongoing regulatory execution risk.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin heads higher as President Trump announces Iran peace agreement
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical de-risking: news of a peace agreement reduced tail-risk premia, supporting risk assets incl. crypto; shows sensitivity of crypto to geopolitical developments.
